claims.text: The rider's claim is that the trip was driven on a longer route than needed. The trip record shows the platform's own optimal route for this booking was 3.2 km, while the GPS trace records 4.05 km actually driven — an excess of 0.85 km, or 26.56% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests are met: the excess exceeds 20% of optimal (26.56%) and exceeds 0.8 km absolute (0.85 km). The deviation is therefore ESTABLISHED on this trip's own trace.

The governing distance figure is the trace, not the rounded trip-record copy. POL-RD-01 requires the threshold test to be run on gps_trace.trace_distance_km, which here is 4.05 km, against the booked optimal of 3.2 km. The trip_record.actual_distance_km of 4.0 km is a rounded convenience copy and may not be cited for the threshold test; using the trace figure the excess is 0.85 km and the deviation still stands.

The rider carries the initial burden under POL-RD-08 and discharges it: the trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry the same trip identifier TRP-02846 and the same pickup/start window (trip started 2026-08-20T10:43:22+08:00, first GPS fix 2026-08-20T10:43:22+08:00), and the excess of 0.85 km / 26.56% meets the POL-RD-01 threshold on an unimpaired trace. The burden therefore shifts to the driver to point to a specific artifact and clause to excuse the excess.

The driver's only answer on file is 'Followed the app.' That is a general assertion which cites no evidence ID and no clause, and under POL-RD-08 an assertion from either side that cites no evidence ID carries no weight and is discarded. The driver has pointed to no traffic_advisory, no chat_log instruction, no amendment and no pooled itinerary, so the burden is not discharged and no exculpatory clause is available.

No traffic advisory covers this trip. The only advisory artifact in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-02846-01, is MISSING with weight 0.0 and its issue detail records that no advisory covers the Blk 108 Yishun Ring Rd corridor in this window. Under POL-RD-13 the driver's implicit external-cause assertion cannot be tested against any advisory, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight; the deviation stands at the measured figure and POL-RD-02 runs against the booked optimal route.

No rider-requested detour can be made out. The chat log for this trip is empty — zero messages, no first or last message timestamp — so there is no rider instruction, no waypoint_hint and no named road to corroborate under POL-RD-04. The clause is unavailable on this record and no distance is excluded from the excess.

No pickup or dropoff relocation applies. The trip_record shows original_pickup and original_dropoff both null, pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null, and amended_optimal_distance_km null. POL-RD-05 cannot be run and no amended optimal substitutes for the booked 3.2 km.

This is not a pooled trip. The trip_record records vehicle_type RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null. POL-RD-12 does not apply and the baseline for POL-RD-01 remains the booked optimal of 3.2 km.

The fare is METERED, so POL-RD-02 governs the remedy. The fare_breakdown records fare_model METERED, charged_total SGD 9.28, surge_multiplier 1.0, platform_fee 0.80, optimal_distance_km 3.2 and optimal_duration_min 6.0. Recomputing on the booked optimal route: ((3.80 + 0.75 x 3.2 + 0.28 x 6.0) x 1.0) + 0.80 = (3.80 + 2.40 + 1.68) + 0.80 = 8.68. The refund is 9.28 - 8.68 = 0.60, which is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and well below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 0.60.

The refund is not de minimis and does not reach the full-refund share. The fare_breakdown's own derived block records refund_before_rounding 0.6000, below_de_minimis false, and reaches_full_refund_share false. The rider is therefore entitled to a partial refund of SGD 0.60, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05, and not to the whole contested amount.

No ERP or surcharge correction is due. The fare_breakdown carries zero ERP lines (erp_gantries empty, tolls_erp 0.0, airport_surcharge 0.0) and the trip neither originates at an airport nor crosses a charged gantry, so there is no off-route or phantom pass-through line to refund under POL-RD-09 and nothing to add on top of the POL-RD-02 figure.

The GPS trace is clean for policy purposes and carries the finding. It has 37 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds, so it does not meet any of the POL-RD-07(a) to (c) impairment limbs; the deviation may be established on the trace alone and no independent corroboration is required.

The driver's profile does not establish a repeat-deviation pattern. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 and completed_trips_90d is 398, so neither POL-RD-06 limb is met (0 is below 3, and 0/398 is below 0.05). No FULL_REFUND uplift and no conduct referral follow on this record; the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter is not the trailing-90-day figure POL-RD-06 asks for and may not be substituted for it.

The rider's profile does not trigger the extra-corroboration rule. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0, below the threshold of 4, so POL-RD-08's additional corroboration requirement for sub-30% excess claims is not engaged and the rider's claim stands on the trace alone.

claims.text: The rider's claim is that the trip was driven on a longer route than needed. The governing measurement is the GPS trace, not the rounded trip-record copy: the trace records 4.05 km against a booked optimal of 3.2 km, an excess of 0.85 km. That excess is 26.56% of optimal, which clears the 20% limb of POL-RD-01, and it clears the 0.8 km absolute limb as well (0.85 km > 0.80 km). Both establishment tests pass, so a deviation is established on this trip's own trace.

The trace is clean for policy purposes: 37 fixes at a 10-second sample interval, 100% coverage, zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds, so no limb (a) to (c) of POL-RD-07 fires. The deviation therefore stands on the trace alone and needs no independent corroboration. The admissibility pre-pass also tags this artifact COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so there is no schema-level impairment to disclose either.

The driver's only answer on the record is 'Followed the app.' That is a bare assertion with no artifact behind it. No traffic advisory is on file for this trip at all - the advisory artifact is MISSING with weight 0.0 - so the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run and the driver's implicit traffic excuse carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Under POL-RD-13 the assertion is tested against the traffic_advisory and nothing else, and with no advisory covering the trip window the assertion is discarded and the deviation stands at the measured figure.

No exculpatory clause is available to the driver on this record. The chat log is empty - zero messages - so there is no rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04 and no rider-supplied address amendment under POL-RD-05. The trip record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null and amended_optimal_distance_km null, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run. The vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. Nothing excuses the excess.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02. The fare model is METERED, so the clause applies. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 3.2 + 0.28 x 6.0) x 1.0 surge) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP + 0 fixed surcharges + 0 waiting time - 0 promo = (3.80 + 2.40 + 1.68) + 0.80 = 8.68. Charged_total is 9.28, so the refund is 9.28 - 8.68 = 0.60, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05, which is 0.60. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor, so it is not de minimis, and it is far below 90% of charged_total, so it is a PARTIAL_REFUND rather than a full one.

The excess of 0.85 km is 26.56% of optimal, which is below the 50% and 8.0 km materiality gates, so this is not a MATERIAL deviation and the POL-RD-06 repeat-pattern check is not triggered. I note for completeness that the driver's trailing-90-day deviation_flags_90d is 0 and completed_trips_90d is 398, so even if the check were run no pattern would be established on the citable fields. The lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter is context only under POL-GEN-01 and is not the field POL-RD-06 names.

On the pass-through lines: the fare breakdown carries zero ERP gantries and zero tolls, and no airport surcharge, so there is no off-route ERP to refund separately and no billing-integrity defect under POL-RD-09(4). The rider's recovery is confined to the POL-RD-02 distance-and-time refund of 0.60, and no ERP amount may be added on top of it.

The rider's profile does not weaken the claim. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so the POL-RD-08 corroboration uplift for a serial claimant (4 or more claims with 1 or fewer substantiated) is not engaged, and the trace alone carries the excess. The rider's other profile fields are context only under POL-GEN-01 and I do not rely on them.

ruling.explanation:
Both sides agree on the core measurement, and the record supports them. The governing distance is the GPS trace at 4.05 km (EV-GPS-02846), not the rounded trip-record copy of 4.00 km; the platform's booked optimal route for this trip was 3.2 km (EV-TRIP-02846). Excess = 4.05 − 3.2 = 0.85 km, which is 26.56% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 tests pass — 26.56% > 20% and 0.85 km > 0.80 km — so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. The trace is clean for policy purposes: 37 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds, so POL-RD-07(a)–(c) does not fire and the deviation stands on the trace alone without corroboration. The excess is below the 50% / 8.0 km materiality gates, so this is not a MATERIAL deviation and the POL-RD-06 pattern check and any conduct referral are not engaged; in any event the driver's citable counters (deviation_flags_90d 0 against 398 completed trips in 90 days) establish no pattern.

No exculpatory clause is available. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02846) is empty — zero messages — so there is no rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04 and no rider-supplied address change under POL-RD-05; the trip record shows original pickup/dropoff null, no amended timestamps and amended_optimal_distance_km null, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run. The vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply and the baseline remains the booked optimal of 3.2 km. The driver's statement 'Followed the app.' (counterparty_statement) cites no evidence ID and no clause; under POL-RD-08 an assertion that cites no evidence carries no weight, and there is no traffic_advisory on file — EV-ADVIS-02846-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 — so the POL-RD-03 closure comparison cannot be run and the driver's explanation neither reduces the excess nor supplies an adjusted optimal (POL-RD-13). Two claims, one from each side, that cited that missing advisory without naming its MISSING_ARTIFACT issue code were discarded by the referee; their substance does not change the arithmetic.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02 (fare_model METERED, read from EV-FARE-02846): recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 × 3.2 + 0.28 × 6.0) × surge 1.0) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP/surcharges + 0 waiting time − 0 promo = (3.80 + 2.40 + 1.68) + 0.80 = 8.68. Charged_total was 9.28 (EV-FARE-02846). Refund = 9.28 − 8.68 = 0.60, which is above the 0.50 de minimis floor and 6.47% of charged, far below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 0.60 (already a multiple of SGD 0.05). There are no ERP gantries, tolls or airport surcharge lines to correct under POL-RD-09, so nothing is added on top of that figure. No driver compensation arises: the fare ledger billed 4.0 km against a 4.05 km trace, a shortfall of 0.05 km, far below the 1.0 km threshold in POL-RD-04.

Confidence: the deciding facts — trace distance and booked optimal (EV-GPS-02846 and EV-TRIP-02846, both weight 1.0) and the fare figures (EV-FARE-02846, weight 1.0) — are carried by artifacts all at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. The monetary effect (SGD 0.60) is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so it executes automatically subject to the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.

ledger.claim: No exculpatory clause is available to the driver on this record. The chat log is empty - zero messages - so there is no rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04 and no rider-supplied address amendment under POL-RD-05. The trip record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null and amended_optimal_distance_km null, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run. The vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. Nothing excuses the excess.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02. The fare model is METERED, so the clause applies. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 3.2 + 0.28 x 6.0) x 1.0 surge) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP + 0 fixed surcharges + 0 waiting time - 0 promo = (3.80 + 2.40 + 1.68) + 0.80 = 8.68. Charged_total is 9.28, so the refund is 9.28 - 8.68 = 0.60, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05, which is 0.60. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor, so it is not de minimis, and it is far below 90% of charged_total, so it is a PARTIAL_REFUND rather than a full one.

The excess of 0.85 km is 26.56% of optimal, which is below the 50% and 8.0 km materiality gates, so this is not a MATERIAL deviation and the POL-RD-06 repeat-pattern check is not triggered. I note for completeness that the driver's trailing-90-day deviation_flags_90d is 0 and completed_trips_90d is 398, so even if the check were run no pattern would be established on the citable fields. The lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter is context only under POL-GEN-01 and is not the field POL-RD-06 names.

ledger.claim: On the pass-through lines: the fare breakdown carries zero ERP gantries and zero tolls, and no airport surcharge, so there is no off-route ERP to refund separately and no billing-integrity defect under POL-RD-09(4). The rider's recovery is confined to the POL-RD-02 distance-and-time refund of 0.60, and no ERP amount may be added on top of it.

The rider's profile does not weaken the claim. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so the POL-RD-08 corroboration uplift for a serial claimant (4 or more claims with 1 or fewer substantiated) is not engaged, and the trace alone carries the excess. The rider's other profile fields are context only under POL-GEN-01 and I do not rely on them.
